import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    odds = [str(x) for x in nums if x % 2 != 0]
    evens = [str(x) for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
    output = odds + evens
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(output))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
